pages.text: Hovers to the side and above you. $(thing)Tell:$() a high swooping cry and a curled abdomen, then it dives in a straight line at where you stood. Sidestep it. Hitting it during the wind-up breaks the dive off.$(br2)Drops a $(l:bosses/arenas)Swamp Sigil Fragment$(/l) when you kill it.
pages.title: Glasswing
